title: Pricing Sync
help: Automatically detects configured backends (excluding local models), fetches prices from official pricing pages / the LiteLLM registry, and creates batches pending confirmation. Select items and click "Apply Selected" to write prices into billing rules.

review.title: Review Sync Batch
review.priceHint: All prices are stored in USD; CNY official sources are converted using the 7.2 rate. Switching currency only affects this display and does not modify billing rules.
review.unresolvedTip: Unresolved models cannot be selected (no price in the official pricing page / LiteLLM registry).
review.usageTip: How to use: select the items to apply, then click "Apply Selected" to write billing rules; "Reject Batch" discards the whole batch.

message.noProposed: No prices to sync (configure non-local backends first)
